extracted.intended_audience: Prospective PhD applicants in applied science, engineering, and mathematics (prospective Hertz Fellowship applicants); partner organizations and donors
extracted.subtask_description: Criteria and program features used to identify and fund up to ~25 exceptional PhD students in applied science, engineering, and mathematics for up to five years; emphasizes potential for high-impact scientific/technological breakthroughs and community leadership.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exceptional innovators / 'the nation’s most exceptional innovators'
rubrics_metrics.description: Fellows are described as 'the nation’s most exceptional innovators' and the fellowship is 'the nation’s most prestigious PhD award in applied science, engineering, and mathematics.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection aims to identify 'exceptional' applicants; each year up to 25 receive the award. Emphasis on exceptional promise in relevant technical fields (applied science, engineering, mathematics).

rubrics_metrics.name: Potential to deliver scientific and technological breakthroughs
rubrics_metrics.description: The Foundation 'has empowered a thriving community of Hertz Fellows in their quest to deliver scientific and technological breakthroughs that change people’s lives for the better.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should demonstrate potential to produce breakthroughs or innovations with real-world impact—work that 'changes people’s lives.' Evidence of novelty, ambition, and applicability is implied.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to solving pressing challenges / public service
rubrics_metrics.description: Hertz Fellows join 'an influential community dedicated to solving our most pressing challenges' and 'share a moral imperative to serve the nation and build a better world.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection favors candidates whose work and motivation align with addressing urgent societal or national challenges and who express a sense of service or societal mission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Visionary problem-solving and lifelong community fit
rubrics_metrics.description: The program looks for 'visionary problem solvers' who will 'join a lifelong community of pioneers dedicated to solving humanity’s most difficult problems.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beyond technical ability, candidates should demonstrate curiosity, collaboration, and long-term engagement with a community of innovators; cultural fit and sustained engagement are valued.

rubrics_metrics.name: Field focus: applied science, engineering, and mathematics
rubrics_metrics.description: The fellowship explicitly targets doctoral students in 'applied science, engineering, and mathematics.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligibility/selection centers on these fields—projects and backgrounds should fall within or strongly connect to applied STEM disciplines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection rigor and funding commitment
rubrics_metrics.description: 'Awarded through a rigorous selection process honed over seven decades, Hertz Fellows receive up to five years of funding.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection is competitive and multi-decade established; the program provides substantial, multi-year support (up to five years), indicating preference for candidates needing sustained doctoral funding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evidence of measurable impact and leadership (impact metrics)
rubrics_metrics.description: The site highlights outcomes such as '375 businesses created,' '54 Members of the National Academies of Sciences, Engineering and Medicine,' and '2 Nobel Laureates.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection likely favors demonstrated leadership, entrepreneurship, or trajectory toward high-impact outcomes (academic honors, company creation, major awards) as indicators of future influence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interdisciplinary engagement and partnership potential
rubrics_metrics.description: Fellows gain opportunities such as 'two summer internships with the Gates Foundation' and collaborations with organizations like Breakthrough Energy and Analog Devices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants who can leverage or benefit from external partnerships, internships, and interdisciplinary collaborations (global health, clean energy, industry R&D) are aligned with program goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advancing American scientific and technological leadership
rubrics_metrics.description: One stated program aim is 'Advancing American scientific and technological leadership.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preference may be given to work that strengthens national leadership in science and technology—research with strategic importance to U.S. competitiveness or public good.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entrepreneurial orientation / translating research to applications
rubrics_metrics.description: The site emphasizes Fellows' roles in entrepreneurship and applied impact ('Businesses created', partnerships to 'advance analog, digital and software technology', etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Candidates demonstrating an orientation toward translating research into products, companies, or deployed technologies are viewed favorably.
